paper.title: Deep Learning Approaches for Continuous Sign Language Recognition: A Comprehensive Review

description: A CSLR-focused review organizing prior methods around spatial features, temporal models and alignment, with datasets and practical challenges.
reason: Meets M1–M3 as a dedicated CSLR review. Section IV.B compares visual CNN/RNN approaches including SubUNets, ReSign and Cui’s iterative-training framework. A previously saved publisher concern notice remains a separate integrity issue.

M1.reason: Explicit literature taxonomy and comparison of prior work.

M2.reason: Sustained CSLR comparison discusses model differences and WER on PHOENIX.

M3.reason: Discussed methods use cropped hands/full video frames and visual CNNs.

evidence.locator: PDF pp.9–11, Section IV.B (CSLR Approaches), Table4
evidence.passage: Discussion compares SubUNets hand/full-frame streams, ReSign CNN-BLSTM/HMM training and Cui gloss-alignment training, with relative WER changes on PHOENIX2014.
